DATAGRAM::l2
Description
This command returns Layer 2 destination address.
Syntax
DATAGRAM
::
l2
dest
Examples
when
FLOW_INIT
{
set
l2_dest
[
DATAGRAM
::
l2
dest
]
log
local0.
"L2 destination MAC $l2_dest"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
FLOW_INIT onward
